verdict.rationale: Paddle documents outbound webhooks that push real-time event notifications to your server (paddle-docs-11). They are secured with a `Paddle-Signature` header (paddle-docs-12, paddle-docs-28) and an IP allowlist (paddle-docs-45), and the official Node and Python SDKs include signature-verification helpers (paddle-docs-49, paddle-docs-50). For the AI-native angle, the hosted MCP server lets agents configure webhooks and simulate events, and agent skills cover webhook integration (paddle-supp-mcp-server, paddle-supp-agent-skills); the Next.js starter kit also uses webhooks to sync data (paddle-docs-60). Missing for 10: an explicit event-type catalog showing how to subscribe to specific events, documented retry/delivery semantics, the API endpoint for registering webhook destinations, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
